note: The site-e2e gate's skip allowance (tools/src/gates/check-site-e2e.ts reads it; nothing generates from it). An entry is { name, match, count, reason, owner, since }: match is the exact flow title, count is how many of the four projects the flow may skip in. A flow that skips more often, a skipped flow with no entry and an entry that allows more skips than happened are all findings, so the allowance falls when a skip is fixed. Edit this file, then run: make site-e2e.

entries.name: phone-home-menu
entries.reason: A phone-width flow: the desktop header carries My marks and the theme toggle itself and has no menu button, so it skips in the two desktop projects.

entries.name: phone-menu
entries.reason: A phone-width flow: the desktop layout pins the sidebar and has no menu button, so it skips in the two desktop projects.

entries.name: action-bar-clear-of-toc
entries.reason: A phone-width flow: the open "On this page" menu is a phone control, so it skips in the two desktop projects.

entries.name: phone-diagram-size
entries.reason: A phone-width flow: the desktop column holds a diagram at its own size, so it skips in the two desktop projects.

entries.name: phone-table-scroll
entries.reason: A phone-width flow: at desktop width the comparison tables fit their column, so it skips in the two desktop projects.

entries.name: toc-tracking
entries.reason: A desktop-width flow: the "On this page" rail shows from 72rem, and below it the phone menu is the outline, so it skips in the two phone projects.

entries.name: draft-chip
entries.reason: No built page declares status: draft, so no hub row can wear the chip and the second half of the flow skips in every project. Delete the entry when a draft page exists.
